component.name: Pairly
component.summary: Connect your Android phone and your PC

description.p: Pairly links your Android phone and your Linux PC over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or an optional relay, with everything end-to-end encrypted.

ul.li: Phone notifications on the PC, with replies and actions
Texts: read and send SMS from the PC
Calls: see who is calling, answer, reject or hang up from the PC
Send files, links and text both ways, and browse the phone's storage
Media controls for players on either device
Use the phone as a touchpad, keyboard or presenter remote
Run the PC's commands, lock it or power it off from the phone
